name: CtaBand
title: CtaBand
summary: Dark `.sec-ink` closing band with a centred eyebrow, headline and two buttons above three numbered columns of ways to take part.
whenToUse: Use once near the end of the home page and Join the Mission, to turn interest into action (pray, give, share).
Use it as the dark beat in the light/dark rhythm of a page.
Use CenteredCta for a lighter, single-message call to action.
whenNotToUse: Do not use more than once per page or directly next to the Hero or Footer without a light section between.

anatomy.description: Reset list styles on the `<ol>` if your page CSS does not (`list-style:none;margin:0;padding-left:0`).

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Eyebrow label, for example "Join the Mission".

props.name: title
props.description: Headline (h2). Wrap one word in `<span className="em">`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Two buttons: a `solidWhite` and an `outlineDark`, both size lg.

props.name: columns
props.description: Exactly three columns; numerals cycle sky blue, gold, violet.

props.name: headingId
props.description: Id of the h2; generated when omitted.

variantNotes: Inset (default): `--radius-lg` corners, 64px × 48px padding, inside the page frame.
Full-bleed: drop the radius when the band spans the viewport.
Columns sit under a 14% white hairline. Under 768px they stack and padding drops to 48px × 24px.
Static; buttons carry their own hover and focus states.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always pair with `.sec-ink` so the background glow, `.em`, `.eyebrow` and headings switch to dark styles.

Buttons: `.btn-light` for the main action and `.btn-outline-light` for the second, both `.btn-lg`. Do not add a Horizon Blue button here if the page already has its primary elsewhere; never two blues.
Exactly three columns, each a title and one sentence. No links inside the columns.
Numerals are text in brand colours, not blue fills or badges.
do: Use once near the end of the home page and Join the Mission, to turn interest into action (pray, give, share).
Use it as the dark beat in the light/dark rhythm of a page.
Use CenteredCta for a lighter, single-message call to action.

accessibility: Label the band with its `h2` via `aria-labelledby`.
Use an `<ol>` for the three columns and hide the numerals from screen readers.
Text on `.sec-ink` uses white and 72% white (`.dp-ctaband-text`), both AA on black.
Keep visible focus rings on the light buttons.
content: Eyebrow "Join the Mission"; headline "Put scripture in someone’s hands today."

Columns: "Pray with us" / "Join a community praying for translators and listeners."; "Give with purpose" / "Fund apps, airtime and printed Bibles."; "Share the Word" / "Hand out NFC cards and recommend the app."
